question: Gustatory receptors are responsible for detecting:
solution:
The correct answer is __**taste**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• With the help of receptors, we smell things with our noses, taste things with our tongues, hear things with our ears, and see things with our eyes.
 
• Receptors are usually located in our sense organs, such as the inner ear, the nose, the tongue, and so on.
 
• The work of gustatory receptors is to detect the taste.
 
• Gustatory receptors are found on the tongue and are evenly distributed across the taste buds. Their primary function is to provide a sense of taste.
 
• With each taste of food or sip of drink, the brain integrates the differential input from the taste buds and a complex flavour is perceived.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Touch detection: The somesthetic receptors will detect touch.
 
• Sound detection: The auditory receptors are located inside the inner ear which helps in Sound detection. 
 
• Smell detection: The olfactory receptors will detect smell.
